rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/161-4_scan003_L1146.jpg the sign after M prime tensor B has two short horizontal strokes and a dark near-vertical/oblique connection at their right ends. That could be a cramped not-equal cross-stroke, but it could also be a terminal joining flourish of an equals sign. The unequivocal not-equal examples in crops/161-4_scan003_L1146_compare.jpg [1275,1265,1555,1335] and crops/161-4_scan003_L1146_quotient.jpg [400,1640,645,1715] have much longer crossing strokes extending beyond both bars; the equals example in crops/161-4_scan003_L1146_equality.jpg [565,865,790,930] has separate bars.
rows.note: The optical evidence does not safely settle the short right-hand stroke. The main reader reviewed the target and all three comparison crops and accepts an explicit unsure{ne|=} in place of the definite equals, retaining both plausible readings. This is an uncertainty edit, not an acceptance based on mathematical intent.
